title: HASH-partitioning a low-cardinality column -- NDV should exceed the partition count (L1-B, not L0)
scenario: MySQL mode, V4.5.0; status has only 6 distinct values, and HASH PARTITIONS 128 is requested. The statement is legal, so the DDL must still be emitted -- with the 122 empty partitions quantified and LIST offered as the corrected design.
anti_example_patterns: Never grounds for calling a design infeasible
A legal statement is never an infeasible design
